[b]🎉 Special Launch Promotion: Exclusive Discounts for Early Participants! 🚀[/b]

Hello, community!

We have an amazing opportunity for those of you following our game, Cain! We want to thank everyone for their support and offer something special. During the pre-launch period, we’re running an exclusive campaign for our most supportive players.

[b]🌟 How does it work?[/b]

Add our game to your [b]Wishlist[/b] on [b]Steam[/b].
Visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3350630/discussions/]Steam Community page[/url] and leave a comment answering: [b]"Why are you excited to play Cain?"[/b]
The [b]first 100 participants[/b] will receive a [b]50% discount code[/b] to use at the game’s launch!

[b]📅 Campaign Period:[/b]
The promotion runs until [b]01/19/2025[/b], so don’t miss out!

[b]🎁 Why participate?[/b]
[b]50% Discount:[/b] A must-have deal for those eager to dive into the game.
[b]Recognition in the community:[/b] Participants will be highlighted in our future posts!
[b]Exclusivity:[/b] This promotion is limited, so only the quickest can benefit.

[b]💡 What else can you do?[/b]
Even if you’re not among the first participants, adding the game to your wishlist is already a huge help and ensures you’ll receive updates first-hand.

[b]📣 Attention:[/b] After the campaign period, we will contact eligible participants directly on Steam to send the codes. Please make sure your account is active and notifications are enabled!

We’re excited to hear from you and can’t wait to share our game with the world.

Thank you so much for your support! 💜
Team: [b]JeffGames[/b]

notes.title: Cain: Redemption or Vengeance Demo Available!
notes.content:
https://youtu.be/lmGfhsa_B8A

[b]Demo of "Cain: Redemption or Vengeance" Now Available![/b]
Get ready to dive into the dark and thrilling world of Cain: Redemption or Vengeance with the release of its official Demo! Now, you can experience the first steps of Cain's journey—a man burdened by a haunting past and choices that will shape his destiny.

In this demo, you’ll get a glimpse of what the full game has to offer, including:

🔹 [b]Phase 1 –[/b] Embark on the initial adventure, facing challenging platforms, deadly traps, and relentless enemies as you explore the intricate details of a devastated and technologically advanced world.
🔹 [b]Time Trial Mini-game –[/b] Test your skills in a dynamic challenge to collect Orbs before the clock runs out, in a format inspired by nostalgic classics.
🔹 [b]Phase 2 –[/b] Overcome even more intense challenges and uncover hidden secrets in an environment that demands precision and courage.

[b]About the Game:[/b]
Take on the role of Cain, a man marked by the guilt of an unescapable sin: the murder of his brother Abel. Carrying the weight of this curse in a post-apocalyptic world, Cain must decide whether to seek redemption or spiral into a path of vengeance.

[b]Why Play the Demo?[/b]

Discover the first steps of a captivating and morally complex narrative.
Test challenging gameplay that combines action, platforming, and decision-making moments.
Explore a detailed universe blending technology and darkness.
The Demo of Cain: Redemption or Vengeance is ready to play. This is your chance to explore the beginning of an epic journey and decide if Cain deserves forgiveness or must embrace his dark fate.

📥 Download the Demo now and prepare for a choice that will define everything!
